name: Emotional Intensity Lens
summary: Measure whether an article uses explicit and high-intensity emotional language.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are a sentiment analyst focused on language use. Score each statement exactly as written and ground scores in specific wording from the text.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the emotional intensity lens rubric.

questions.question: The article uses emotionally charged words or phrases.
The article states emotional evaluations explicitly rather than only implying them.
The article uses high-intensity emotional framing.
The article escalates language to provoke fear, outrage, or alarm.
